description: A headless dead body of a person.  Its wound looks deep and hollow…
The wreckage of a Secronom reinforcer drone.  Its deployment hardware is ruined, but the chassis still contains salvageable robotic components.
The wreckage of a Secronom shocker drone.  Its electrical systems are dead and its cutting assembly hangs loose.
The wreckage of a Secronom rifle walker.  The weapon mount and locomotion systems are disabled beyond field repair.
The wreckage of a Secronom launcher drone.  Its flight and missile systems are destroyed, leaving a salvageable robotic chassis.
